key_idea: Count teeth: when the small cog turns once, the big cog turns only half way.
steps: At the start, the small black tooth is on the right of the small cog. The big black tooth is on the left of the big cog. They touch.
The small cog has 4 teeth. When it makes one full turn, 4 teeth of the big cog go past.
The big cog has 8 teeth, and 4 is half of 8. So the big cog turns half way around.
The small black tooth is back on the right. The big black tooth moves from the left to the right side of the big cog.

choice_feedback.A: This is how they start. The big cog turns too, so its black tooth moves.
choice_feedback.B: After one full turn, the small black tooth is back where it started, on the right.
